description: Changes where the video of a webinar comes from: the live room (100ms, an embedded YouTube or Vimeo clip, or an MP4), the teaser on the registration page, or the video on the thank-you page. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. Participants see the new source the next time their room or page loads; no text and no date changes. Needs `session_id` and `webinar_id` from wi_list_webinars. Use `provider` for a live webinar (100ms or embed), `video_source` for the embed code or a YouTube or Vimeo link, `room_video_url` for an MP4 in the evergreen room, and `registration_video_url` or `thankyou_video_url` for those pages. `settings` is the long tail of video and room fields by their real name, only passed keys change. Switching a room away from a CONNECTED 100ms account needs `video_switch_confirm`, because the site never silently drops a live connection. For the connected account itself use wi_connect_streaming, for the state wi_get_streaming_status.

confirm.description: Only after the site answered code admin_editing: the host agreed to overwrite unsaved changes in wp-admin.

provider.description: Live webinar: 100ms uses the connected 100ms account, embed uses an embedded YouTube or Vimeo clip.

registration_video_url.description: The teaser clip on the registration page (MP4 or YouTube link).

room_video_url.description: Evergreen room: the MP4 the room plays.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

settings.description: Further video and room fields by their real name, only passed keys change, e.g. lp_cta_type, webinar_source_toggle, auto_video_length, webinar_youtube_url.

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

thankyou_video_url.description: The clip on the thank-you page (MP4).

video_source.description: The embedded clip: a full iframe embed code, or a YouTube or Vimeo link. Works on the free licence too.

video_switch_confirm.description: Only after the site answered code video_100ms_switch_needs_confirm: the host agreed to move the room off an active 100ms connection.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_video
title: Change the video of a webinar
